environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label set to 'restricted' profile in enforce mode (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-volumes' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing spec.volumes[*].hostPath. The restricted PSS profile independently rejects containers with securityContext.privileged: true, runAsUser: 0, and any volume type other than configMap, secret, emptyDir, downwardAPI, persistentVolumeClaim, projected, ephemeral, and csi. The application container runs as non-root UID 1000 with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and config is supplied via a Kubernetes ConfigMap mounted at /etc/app/config.json with valid authMode and no diagnosticsCommand field.
